description: Source code for the DIDExplorerPage React component, which manages DID search, agent selection, and reasoner display in a web UI.

methods.name: DIDExplorerPage
methods.description: Main React component for the DID Explorer page, handling search, agent display, and reasoner details.

methods.name: fetchRecentAgents
methods.description: Fetches the list of recent agents from the API.

methods.name: performSearch
methods.description: Performs a DID search query with pagination.

methods.name: fetchAgentReasoners
methods.description: Fetches reasoners for a selected agent.

methods.name: handleAgentClick
methods.description: Handles the event when a user clicks on an agent, loading its reasoners.

methods.name: handleCopyDID
methods.description: Copies the specified DID to clipboard.

methods.name: handleRefresh
methods.description: Refreshes search results or recent agents depending on context.

methods.name: handleBackToList
methods.description: Resets view to the list of recent agents.
